It created quite a stir when the Centre informed the Delhi High Court that a look-out circular, or an LOC, had been issued against Cockroach Janta Party co-convenor Saurav Das. Until then, the existence of this LOC was not publicly known. ThePrint has now learnt that the LOC was issued in connection with an FIR registered over a CJP protest in Mumbai on 2 October. Watch this video by Ananya Bhardwaj to know more.
